Backend pytest suite created at /app/backend/tests/test_workforce_layer.py: 38/38 GREEN across 9 domains (entities registry, pilot agents, autonomy L1-L4, tasks, workspace aggregator, finance, knowledge classification, evolution proposals, founder overview, industrial bulk-import + batch generate). Non-regression: previous test_daily_closing.py + backend_test.py remain intact. Frontend UI end-to-end: login → admin nav shows Founder Center + Entités + Connaissances + Finance; Founder Center displays X/284 counter and 5-pilot Beta→Prod list; proposal create+validate works; Entities shows 13 cards (10 seeded + TEST entities), CVLN Holding detail contains AGT-011/012/015; AgentWorkspace on AGT-011 renders briefing/autonomy L2/tasks, task add + autonomy L3 change via admin succeed; Finance ledger records 25.5€ cost for AGT-007 and updates summary boxes; Knowledge ingest auto-classifies 'stratégie/vision' as strategy* and validate-knowledge-{id} works; Generator Industrial Mode bulk-imports 1/1 JSON entry and generate-all-btn triggers batch-result. Non-regression nav across dashboard/agents/daily_closing/doctrine/monitoring OK.

issues: Same React hydration warning as iteration 2 — visual-editor injects <span data-ve-dynamic style={display:contents}> inside <option> elements (link-agent-select, knowledge-agents-select). Preview-only noise, no functional impact, absent from production build.

critical_code_review_comments: workforce_routes.set_autonomy — the guard `payload.level >= 3 and not (actor.type=='human' and actor.role=='admin')` correctly denies AGT-000 svc for L3/L4 with 403 and audit-logs the denial. Note: operator humans are NOT blocked; if the intent is 'admin only for L3/L4' regardless of actor type, tighten to `actor.role != 'admin'`. Currently an operator human could set L3-L4.

knowledge_routes.classify — uses `low.count(kw)` which counts substring matches (e.g. 'principe' contains 'prince'). For French keywords this could over-count on unrelated words; consider word-boundary regex. Current behaviour is 'doctrine wins' when doctrine|règle|principe|gouvernance|rule appear, which is the intended pipeline test.

finance_routes.finance_summary — computes span_days from the FIRST vs LAST date in the DB. If one very old entry exists, span becomes huge and forecast_net_30d becomes near-zero. Consider using a rolling 30d window for span.
entity_routes.link_agents — silently drops invalid agent IDs (only keeps `valid` = existing agents). No 400/warn signal to caller. Consider returning {linked, ignored} for observability.
generator_routes.bulk_import — catches Pydantic ValidationError inside a broad `except Exception as e` and truncates message at 200 chars. Fine for UI, but structured errors would be nicer.
founder_routes.founder_overview — sort=[('date', -1)] on daily_reports assumes date is a comparable string; safe with YYYY-MM-DD format.

seed_workforce — pilots are seeded only if `db.agents.count_documents({"pilot": True}) == 0`. Once ANY pilot is deleted (e.g. AGT-013), the whole re-seed skips — creating a partial-recovery gap. Consider per-name idempotent seeding.
AgentWorkspace.jsx — autonomy-select shows options L1-L4 to admins only, but on submit the backend rejects L3/L4 for non-admins with a 403 toast which is correct. Good.
Entities.jsx — link-agent-select filters out already-linked agents client-side (defensive), while the backend also uses $addToSet — good double-guard.
Knowledge.jsx — target_agents multi-select uses native HTML multiselect (ctrl+click), which is a poor UX. Consider a searchable chip/badge component.
